verdict.rationale: The evidence shows RunAnywhere processes data on-device and treats local versus hosted execution as an explicit choice. That is a related privacy control, not a documented way to pick a storage region or data-residency location. Nothing in the pack describes region selection or residency guarantees for the hosted Wally cloud, so the region/residency capability itself is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
